title: What actually happens behind the scenes when you pay via UPI?
hooks: Google Pay ya PhonePe aapka ek rupya bhi transfer nahi karte.
Aapka UPI app aapka paisa kabhi haath bhi nahi lagata.
PIN daala aur do second mein payment done... par beech mein paisa kahan gaya?
hook_why: Contrarian hook that immediately shatters user assumption that payment apps move the actual money, driving high watch retention.
metaphor: NPCI ek central air traffic controller hai jo bina paisa chuve do alag banks ke beech transaction route karta hai.

scenes.vo: Google Pay or PhonePe never actually transfer a single rupee of yours.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic close-up macro shot of a sleek smartphone screen resting on a dark slate surface, displaying a subtle green glowing payment ring with soft rim lighting, photorealistic studio tech product render on pure black background, no text on screen.
scenes.label: PAYMENT APPS

scenes.vo: Enter PIN, transfer done in two seconds, but what happened behind?
scenes.title: SETTLEMENT SPEED
scenes.label: TIME BREAKDOWN

scenes.vo: The truth is these apps are just acting like digital postmen.
scenes.prompt: Minimalist illuminated glowing data packet capsule floating inside a dark digital glass conduit, soft volumetric cyan lighting, premium cinematic 3D render on pure dark background, no text.
scenes.label: DATA CARRIER

scenes.vo: The moment you enter your PIN, the app locks and forwards it to NPCI.
scenes.prompt: Premium matte-black cryptographic security vault token with a faint glowing golden cipher lock core, dramatic moody edge lighting, isolated on solid black background, hyper-detailed product studio render.
scenes.label: ENCRYPTED PIN

scenes.vo: NPCI is the national switchboard that connects all banks together instantly.
scenes.prompt: Futuristic centralized banking network server core with glowing golden circuit tracks and deep blue fiber connections, photorealistic tech render on pure black, clean minimal composition.
scenes.label: NPCI SWITCH

real.subject: National Payments Corporation of India logo

scenes.vo: NPCI asks your bank directly: is the PIN correct and funds available?
scenes.label: VERIFICATION

scenes.vo: As soon as the bank confirms, money gets debited from your account.
scenes.title: REMITTER CORE BANKING
scenes.label: DEBIT SIGNAL

scenes.vo: Then NPCI tells the receiver bank to credit the funds right away.
scenes.title: BENEFICIARY SYSTEM
scenes.label: CREDIT SIGNAL

scenes.vo: The moment both banks reply OK, a green tick appears on your screen.
scenes.prompt: Sleek floating emerald acrylic success token glowing with a bright minimalist checkmark contour, soft warm rim light, premium dark fintech aesthetics on solid black background.
scenes.label: VERIFIED
scenes.title: STATUS

scenes.vo: Money went strictly bank to bank, no third-party app touched it.
scenes.label: TRANSFER
scenes.title: DIRECT

scenes.vo: Did you think PhonePe sent the money? Drop the truth in comments!
scenes.title: TRUTH
scenes.label: REPLY

caption:
PhonePe and Google Pay don't actually transfer a single rupee of yours! See how NPCI and your bank finish the settlement in just 2 seconds. Did you even know this?

Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

claims.claim: Third-party UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe) do not hold customer deposits or directly transfer money; settlement occurs bank-to-bank.
claims.basis: NPCI Unified Payments Interface framework: TPAPs operate as front-end application providers on top of sponsor and member Core Banking Systems.

claims.claim: The encrypted transaction request routes via the NPCI switch to verify credentials with the remitter bank CBS before notifying the beneficiary bank.
claims.basis: NPCI UPI Operating Guidelines and core transaction routing flows.
